items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: He played with the Lloyd Canada, Steve and and Joe and the other one... All played together

ctx.x: Almond said how wonderful it was he could just walk in the studio and hear those tunes and come up.

That's right. He's a good man. He played with the Lloyd Canada, Steve and and Joe and the other one. What were the other boys? Freddie. Freddie. He played with them. Well are you all related? No, no relation with it at all. All Lloyd Canada, no relations? No relations at all. All played together and had a bit of relations.
You practically had your nothing but Lloyd Canada's in the band. That's right, that's right. What would you do with a 50-piece jazz band? Oh god. I don't believe you'd be able to play
